name: OpenTelemetry Collector 指标
description: 从 Grafana 面板迁移并汉化，已转换为“我的面板”原生格式。来源：otel-collector。

variables.name: cluster_id
variables.label: 集群
variables.query:
SELECT DISTINCT scope_id AS __value, 
CASE 
  WHEN c.name != '' THEN c.name
  ELSE scope_id
END AS __text
FROM data_scope 
LEFT JOIN clusters c ON scope_id  = c.id
WHERE type = 'cluster'

query.expression:
# receivers
label_replace(
  label_join(
    label_join(
      sum(${metric:raw}(
        otelcol_receiver_accepted_spans${suffix}{job="$job"}[$__rate_interval])
      ) by (receiver)
      , "id", "-rcv-", "transport", "receiver"
    )
    , "title", "", "transport", "receiver"
  )
  , "icon", "arrow-to-right", "", ""
)

# dummy processor
or
label_replace(
  label_replace(
    label_replace(
      (sum(rate(otelcol_process_uptime${suffix}{job="$job"}[$__rate_interval])))
      , "id", "processor", "", ""
    )
    , "title", "Processor(s)", "", ""
  )
  , "icon", "arrow-random", "", ""
)

# exporters
or
label_replace(
  label_join(
    label_join(
      sum(${metric:raw}(
        otelcol_exporter_sent_spans${suffix}{job="$job"}[$__rate_interval])
      ) by (exporter)
      , "id", "-exp-", "transport", "exporter"
    )
    , "title", "", "transport", "exporter"
  )
  , "icon", "arrow-from-right", "", ""
)
